description: A manifest with no `repository`. One of the two points with two modes: day to day it warns (as long as the repository has no remote, that is unreadiness to release, not a build error), and under `--release` it blocks, because npm refuses provenance. The fixture examines both directions — an assertion on "it blocks" alone would let through a regression after which point 6 always blocks. A dry run packs the same manifest, so under `--rehearsal` the point blocks as in a release.
